description: Combines searchIdentifiers and searchText for a symbol, deduplicates by file:line, and returns up to limit matches as {file, line, text}. Scope: whole repository, syntactic candidates only. Limits: capped at limit results, so a declaration may be missed for frequent symbols.

outputContract.returns: { file: string; line: number; text: string; }[]
